title: Thien Hau Temple (Cholon)
geometryBasis: The native map fixes the 710 Nguyễn Trãi compound, two lateral wings, rear building and three street gates. The historic timber temple is about 65 m long by 27 m wide. Its open forecourt is within the longer mapped site.
sectionBasis: The clear entrance, open incense court and ceramic roof views guide the architectural sections. Interior roof boundaries, roof heights, secondary range elevations and floor levels remain estimates.
limitations: The model represents the exterior, axial halls and visible courtyards in September 2019. Individual ceramic figures are simplified and the shrine furnishings are outside the model scope.
The mapped compound and annexes anchor the footprint. Heights and unmeasured roof sections are estimated from the exterior and courtyard views.
The urban source elevation field is kept intact. Contact and interior paving levels use approximate vertical registration.
